# Bitly API (4.0.0)

OpenAPI Specification: [Download](https://dev.bitly.com/v4/v4.json)

## Bitlinks

Bitlinks are shortened links. They could begin with the bit.ly domain or your own custom branded short domain (BSD).

**Related Operations:**

- [POST /bitlinks](https://dev.bitly.com/api-reference/#createFullBitlink) \- Create a new bitlink or add a custom keyword to an existing bitlink
- [PATCH /bitlinks/{bitlink}](https://dev.bitly.com/api-reference/#updateBitlink) \- Redirect an existing bitlink

### Shorten a Link

#### Post   /v4/shorten

Converts a long url to a Bitlink. You may see errors returned from this endpoint - "DNS\_CONFIGURATION\_ERROR" occurs if you are attempting to shorten links against a custom domain which doesn't have DNS properly configured.

#### Request Body Schema

Default: "bit.ly"

### Create a Bitlink

#### Post   /v4/bitlinks

Converts a long url to a Bitlink and sets additional parameters. You may see errors returned from this endpoint - "DNS\_CONFIGURATION\_ERROR" occurs if you are attempting to shorten links against a custom domain which doesn't have DNS properly configured.

#### Request Body Schema

long\_urlstring

URL to be shortened. Required when creating new bitlinks. Cannot be used with bitlink\_id.

domainstring

Default: "bit.ly"

group\_guidstring

Always include a specific group and custom domain in your shorten calls.

titlestring

tagsarray of string

deeplinksarray of object

app\_idstring

app\_uri\_pathstring

install\_urlstring

install\_typestring

Enum: "no\_install""auto\_install""promote\_install"

force\_new\_linkboolean

keywordstring

Custom keyword for creating keyword overrides. If provided, creates an override at domain/keyword

bitlink\_idstring

Existing bitlink ID to add a keyword override to. Format: domain/hash. Cannot be used with long\_url

expiration\_atstring

Optional expiration timestamp for the bitlink (e.g., 2025-01-28T14:30:00+0000). Minimum expiration time is 5 minutes from now and maximum is 1 year.

dynamic\_routingarray of object

dynamic routing rules for this bitlink.

long\_urlstring

The destination URL for requests matching this rule.

country\_matcharray

ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes that trigger this rule (e.g., \["US", "CA"\]).

country\_excludearray

ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes that must NOT match for this rule to apply.

region\_matcharray

ISO 3166-2 region codes that trigger this rule (e.g., \["US-CA", "CA-ON"\]).

region\_excludearray

ISO 3166-2 region codes that must NOT match for this rule to apply (e.g., \["US-CA", "CA-ON"\]).

device\_matcharray

Device types that trigger this rule (e.g., \["mobile", "tablet"\]).

device\_excludearray

Device types that must NOT match for this rule to apply.

os\_matcharray

Operating systems that trigger this rule (e.g., \["ios", "android"\]).

os\_excludearray

Operating systems that must NOT match for this rule to apply.

### Get Clicks for a Bitlink

#### Get   /v4/bitlinks/{bitlink}/clicks

Returns the click counts for the specified link in an array based on a date.

#### Path Parameters

bitlinkstringRequired

A Bitlink made of the domain and hash

#### Query Parameters

unitstringRequired

A unit of time

Default: "day"

Enum: "minute""hour""day""week""month"

unitsintegerRequired

An integer representing the time units to query data for. pass -1 to return all units of time

Default: -1

unit\_referencestring

An ISO-8601 timestamp, indicating the most recent time for which to pull metrics. Will default to current time. Timestamp values should be url encoded (i.e. replace '+' with '%2B' and ':' with '%3A'; 2022-02-02T15:53:02+0000 becomes 2022-02-02T15%3A53%3A02%2B0000)

## Bulk Upload

Bulk Upload lets users upload a CSV or XLSX file to create links, QR codes, or both in one request.

### Create a bulk upload

#### Post   /v4/organizations/{organization\_guid}/bulk\_uploads

Creates a bulk upload in a group of the organization and returns a signed URL and headers for the file upload.

To complete a bulk upload:
1\. Call this endpoint with the \`group\_guid\` for the new links. Set \`domain\` to a custom domain of the group. Set \`upload\_type\` to the item that each row creates: \`link\` for a link, \`qr\_code\` for a QR code, or \`coupled\_link\` for a link and its QR code. For \`qr\_code\` and \`coupled\_link\`, also set \`template\_id\`.
2\. Send the file in a \`PUT\` request to \`upload\_url\`. Include every header in \`headers\` without changes, including \`Content-Type\`. The upload fails if any header is different. The file can be up to 25,000,000 bytes (25 MB), and a larger file gets \`400 EntityTooLarge\`. The URL is valid until \`upload\_url\_expires\_at\`.

Processing is asynchronous. When it is complete, Bitly emails a report to the user's verified primary email address and to the organization admins. The report shows the result and the short link for each row. The request returns \`400 INVALID\_EMAIL\` if the user has no verified primary email address.

File format: the first row must contain the column headers. Each other row describes one item to create. \`Long URL\` is the only required column. The optional columns are \`Title\`, \`Tags\` (comma-separated if more than one), \`Backhalf\`, \`Expiration\` (for example \`2030-01-31T15:04:05+0000\`), \`UTM Source\`, \`UTM Medium\`, \`UTM Campaign\`, \`UTM Term\`, \`UTM Content\`, and \`Current Bitly Short Link\`. A row with \`Current Bitly Short Link\` changes the destination of that existing link and does not create a new link. A \`qr\_code\` upload ignores the \`Backhalf\`, \`Tags\`, and \`Current Bitly Short Link\` columns. The maximum number of rows in one file depends on the plan. For examples, see \[How do I shorten links in bulk?\](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056277331) and \[How do I create QR Codes in bulk?\](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/25227111392397-How-do-I-create-QR-Codes-in-bulk).

#### Post   /v4/groups/{group\_guid}/exports

Build a CSV export synchronously and return it inline as a base64 data URI plus metadata.
The export\_type field selects the CSV shape: link\_engagements\_batch (engagement metrics for
explicit bitlinks or a filter), links\_list (link metadata roster), or qr\_codes\_list (QR code
metadata roster). Row caps apply per request: 200 rows when metrics are included
(link\_engagements\_batch, or include\_metrics on a list export); 1000 rows for metadata-only
list exports. When the match set exceeds the cap, truncated is true and only the first
cap rows are returned; row\_count reports how many data rows are in the CSV.

the caller already knows the exact links. Mutually exclusive with filter (provide one or the other).

unix\_frominteger
